name: Commit pipeline fix_errors/format no progress (perceived hang)
description: Real failure: User reported 'hanged?' when agent ran execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=['fix_errors','format']). No progress is sent for fix_errors/format, so UI looks frozen for 1-3+ minutes. Task validates that progress reporting or documented wait expectation exists for long-running pre-commit steps.
expected_outcome: Either progress is reported during fix_errors/format, or commit workflow documents 1-3 min wait; user does not assume hang.

name: Commit pipeline test step exceeds MCP tool timeout
description: Real failure: execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=['tests']) hits 600s MCP wrapper limit while full suite needs ~900s; tool always returns timeout. Task validates test step completes or timeout is sufficient.
expected_outcome: Test step completes within tool timeout, or MCP timeout for this tool is increased so full suite can finish.

name: MCP connection closed during fix_markdown_lint
description: Real failure: fix_markdown_lint(include_untracked_markdown=true) ran; client closed connection before response (MCP error -32000). Task validates retry-once then fallback and documentation.
expected_outcome: On connection closed: retry once; if retry fails, use shell fallback and record 'MCP connection closed; fallback used'; do not skip Step 12.5.

name: fix_markdown_lint file discovery blocks event loop
description: Real failure: fix_markdown_lint with check_all_files uses synchronous Path.rglob on event loop; blocks for tens of seconds with no progress. Task validates file discovery runs off event loop (e.g. to_thread).
expected_outcome: File discovery does not block event loop; progress or chunking reduces perceived hang.

name: Implement workflow without load_context at step start
description: Real failure: Session optimization reported 'No session logs for load_context'; implement ran without loading context. Task validates load_context is called at step start with task-appropriate budget.
expected_outcome: load_context(task_description=..., token_budget=...) called at implement step start; session logs show context usage.

name: Duplicate completed-work entries in activeContext
description: Real failure: Session optimization noted 'Duplicate E2E Plan Test entries in activeContext' from repeated completions. Task validates single canonical entry per plan completion or dedupe.
expected_outcome: No duplicate completed-work bullets for same plan; dedupe or single canonical entry per plan completion.

name: Full-content roadmap write causing corruption
description: Real failure: Using manage_file(roadmap.md, write, full_content) causes corruption; roadmap must use helper tools only. Task validates only remove_roadmap_entry/add_roadmap_entry/register_plan_in_roadmap for edits.
expected_outcome: Roadmap edits use dedicated helpers; no full-content write to roadmap.md for single-entry changes.

name: Plan created but not registered in roadmap
description: Real failure: create_plan used without register_plan_in_roadmap; roadmap corruption or orphan plans. Task validates new plan is registered in roadmap via register_plan_in_roadmap.
expected_outcome: After create_plan, register_plan_in_roadmap is called so roadmap contains the new plan entry.

name: Step 12.1 (format) skipped after MCP connection close
description: Real failure: Agent skipped Step 12.1 using Phase A results after connection closed; new files created in Step 4 may be unformatted. Task validates Step 12.1 always runs in Step 12 or fallback used.
expected_outcome: Step 12.1 (format fix and check) executes in Step 12; if MCP fails, fallback scripts (Black) used; never skip based on Phase A.

name: Step 12.7 (tests) skipped after connection close
description: Real failure: Agent proceeded to commit without re-running tests when Step 12.7 failed with connection error. Task validates commit is blocked if Step 12.7 cannot complete; no fallback.
expected_outcome: If Step 12.7 fails after retry, commit is blocked; Phase A test results are not sufficient.

name: autofix not retried on connection failure
description: Real failure: autofix fails due to connection issues; agent does not retry. Task validates retry once on connection closed, then proceed with execute_pre_commit_checks for gates.
expected_outcome: On connection closed for autofix: retry once; then rely on execute_pre_commit_checks for quality gate.

name: Rules not loaded before applying fix-path changes
description: Real failure: Agent applied type or visibility fixes without loading rules first. Task validates rules(operation='get_relevant', ...) or rule files read before fix-path code changes.
expected_outcome: Before fix-path: load_context and rules loaded; fixes follow project rules and visibility standards.
common_failure_modes: reportPrivateUsage or type fixes without rules

name: Commit pipeline load_context with zero budget
description: Real failure: Zero-budget or zero-files load_context for non-trivial commit/fix work. Task validates load_context for commit/fix uses explicit non-zero budget (e.g. 10k-15k).
expected_outcome: For commit or fix-path tasks, load_context is called with token_budget >= 10000 (no zero budget).

name: manage_file called with missing file_name or operation
description: Real failure: manage_file({}) or omit file_name/operation causes structured error. Task validates all manage_file calls include file_name and operation.
expected_outcome: Every manage_file call has file_name and operation; no empty or partial payload.

name: rules called without operation parameter
description: Real failure: rules() without operation returns structured error. Task validates rules(operation='index'|'get_relevant') with task_description when get_relevant.
expected_outcome: rules() always includes operation; get_relevant includes task_description.

name: Hardcoding memory bank or plans path
description: Real failure: Code or prompts hardcode .cortex/memory-bank or .cortex/plans. Task validates paths resolved via get_structure_info or get_cortex_path.
expected_outcome: No hardcoded .cortex paths; use get_structure_info() or path resolver utilities.

name: Step 12 output truncation hiding errors
description: Real failure: Using | tail or | head in Step 12 hides errors; verification impossible. Task validates full output is read and parsed for all Step 12 checks.
expected_outcome: No output truncation in Step 12; full tool output parsed; error counts verified zero.

name: Submodule has uncommitted changes after Step 11
description: Real failure: Step 11.5 must run; if submodule status --porcelain is non-empty after 11.4, commit must be blocked. Task validates no uncommitted submodule changes before Step 12.
expected_outcome: Step 11.5 run; submodule clean before Step 12; block commit if uncommitted changes in submodule.

name: Type check must run on both src and tests
description: Real failure: Step 12.2 is authoritative; type_check must run on both src/ and tests/ to match CI. Task validates type_check scope includes tests.
expected_outcome: execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=['type_check']) runs on src/ and tests/; 0 errors 0 warnings.

name: Perceived hang after fix_markdown_lint (tests step next)
description: Real failure: User saw 'tool hung'; transcript showed fix_markdown_lint returned then next call (tests) or session ended. Task validates tests step or follow-up has clear timeout and progress.
expected_outcome: After fix_markdown_lint, next step (e.g. tests) has visible progress or documented timeout; no silent stall.

name: Format step blocks event loop (perceived hang)
description: Real failure: execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=['format']) uses synchronous subprocess.run(); blocks event loop 10-60+ seconds with no progress. Task validates format runs off event loop (e.g. to_thread).
expected_outcome: Format adapter work does not block event loop; progress or to_thread used.

name: Session freeze after format tool result
description: Real failure: Format tool returned but no subsequent assistant turn; user saw hang. Task validates next step runs or session/stdio handling is robust.
expected_outcome: After format result, agent proceeds to Step 1.5/2 or session end is explicit; no silent stall.

name: Running raw pytest in Shell instead of MCP tests check
description: Real failure: Agent ran raw pytest in Shell when coverage was below 90%; large output and long run; session ended after Shell with no follow-up. Task validates tests run via execute_pre_commit_checks only.
expected_outcome: Tests executed only via execute_pre_commit_checks(checks=['tests']); no raw pytest in Shell for commit pipeline.
common_failure_modes: Coverage threshold not enforced by tool

name: Optimization config properties never read at runtime
description: Real failure: optimization.json has properties (e.g. enabled, max_budget, reserve_for_response) that are never read; config drift. Task validates critical config keys are wired to behavior.
expected_outcome: Documented config keys are either used at runtime or explicitly documented as unused; no silent drift.

name: Direct Write/StrReplace on memory bank path
description: Real failure: Using Write, StrReplace, or ApplyPatch on memory-bank paths causes violation; all edits must use manage_file. Task validates no direct file tools on memory_bank files.
expected_outcome: All memory bank updates use manage_file(operation='read'|'write') or dedicated append/remove helpers; no Write/StrReplace on memory-bank paths.
common_failure_modes: Direct file write to memory bank

name: MCP health check before Step 12.7
description: Real failure: Long test run can cause connection staleness; Step 12.7 should be preceded by check_mcp_connection_health. Task validates health check runs before tests in final gate.
expected_outcome: check_mcp_connection_health() called before Step 12.7; if unhealthy, block or wait; reduces timeout during tests.
